messages:
tess.docs: Quick check  I'm drafting a short section for SOC2/audit-log docs describing region residency and a tiny migration table: numeric presets -> names. Also noticed the Ruby SDK example link 404s. Can legal + eng review?

rachel.legal: Keep it conservative. Suggest: "Audit logs are retained per tenant-configured retention settings. If copies are created in other regions for disaster recovery, the same retention and access controls apply; key residency and customer-managed keys are respected per tenant configuration."

tess.docs: thanks, I'll use that. Planning to map: 30d -> "compact", 90d -> "balanced", 365d -> "extended". Want two short examples to illustrate.

omar.eng: Technical note: replicas are created only for DR for tenants without residency enforcement. Replicas carry TTL metadata so they expire according to the original retention. Cross-region copies are re-encrypted using the tenant CMK when configured; otherwise our managed key is used.

ben.prod: Product request: add one-line Console tooltip text pointing to the doc: "Presets are recommended retention windows; see docs for residency and KMS details." We'll add a follow-up task for the Console team.

tess.docs: draft examples: - compact (30d): stored in-region by default; no DR replication unless configured. - extended (365d): may be replicated for DR purposes; replicas respect original TTL and access controls. Also adding: "Contact Sales for Private deployments if you require strict region residency."

rachel.legal: tiny tweak: replace "no DR replication unless configured" with "no replication by default; replicas may be created for DR purposes". Otherwise LGTM.

omar.eng: I'll create a redirect for the old Ruby example path. New example lives at https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-ruby/blob/main/examples/audit/export.rb. Use that link (not raw). ETA EOD.

tess.docs: updated wording and will open PR with migration table and SDK link swap. PR will also include the Console tooltip copy as a follow-up.

mirror-bot: PR opened by tess.docs  docs/audit-retention: add preset name mappings, residency examples, and fix Ruby SDK example link (PR #1311) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1311

ben.prod: great. After merge I'll file the Console task. Closing thread unless legal wants more edits.
